disease_reason:
Matched symptoms: leaves turning yellow, yellowing, wilting | Crop identified as: Tomato | Evidence: In the given image tomato wilt symptoms are noticed:
Yellowing of lower leaves, wilting, and drooping. Plants may die in severe cases.

Control Measures:
Cultural: Use resistant varieties; rotate crop...
care_guidance: Apply copper-based bactericide (copper hydroxide or copper oxychloride).
Remove and destroy infected plants immediately to prevent spread.
Sanitize tools, hands, and equipment after handling infected plants.
Avoid working with plants when they are wet.
Use disease-free seed and resistant varieties when available.
Rotate crops and avoid planting the same family for 2–3 years.
